name: Alex Medina
headline: Senior front-end engineer, full-stack when it counts
location: Long Beach, CA. Open to remote roles.
availability: Open to senior roles. Most interested in senior full-stack roles with a front-end focus, Shopify and React work, and AI agent and LLM product work.
summary: 14 years shipping for the web for startups, agencies, and in-house teams. From 2022 to 2026 Alex was a Senior Front-End Engineer at SDG in Los Angeles, building large custom headless (Hydrogen) and Liquid Shopify storefronts and custom Shopify apps for brands like Barnes & Noble, Netflix, SKIMS, Glossier, MoMA, Peet's Coffee, HAUS Labs, and Indigo. Alex also built alxdnAI, the self-hosted agent that answers questions on alxdna.dev, with its own tools, guardrails, transcript logging, and eval suite.
about: Alex drew and painted from childhood through high school, so he started community college in visual art. He also played guitar as a teen, and music pulled him toward jazz guitar. A friend from the music program, after the two had played in bands together, thought Alex would make a great programmer and started teaching him the basics of web development. Alex transferred to CSUF as a music student, then switched to computer science before leaving to build for the web full-time.

skills.Front end: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Remix, Vue, HTML, CSS, and SCSS
skills.Shopify: Hydrogen, Liquid, custom Shopify apps, and Shopify Flow. Shopify badges: Developing Apps for Shopify, and Liquid Storefronts for Theme Developers
skills.Design: UI and product design for Maps On Maps and alxdna.dev, prototyped with AI design tools and shipped in code. Design systems, light and dark themes, and a background in visual art. Design is a supporting strength; Alex is a front-end engineer first
skills.Back end and ops: Node, PHP, SQL, WordPress, Ubuntu, Apache2, DigitalOcean, and Cloudflare Workers
skills.AI and agents: Daily use of Claude and Codex in engineering workflows. Built alxdnAI: a tool-calling agent on a self-hosted open-weights model (Qwen2.5 via Ollama), with guardrails, transcript review, and a regression eval suite
skills.Mobile: Expo and React Native (iOS, Android, and web) for Maps On Maps

education.notes: Started a B.A. in Music Performance (jazz guitar), switched to a B.S. in Computer Science, then left to work full-time as a web developer. No degree was completed.
Studied art, engineering, and music, then transferred to CSUF.

contact.note: Email is the best way to reach Alex. Alex does not share a phone number publicly.
